_metadata.description: Expanded September 2026 target obligations; planned protocols are not execution evidence.

requirements.title: Inspectable intended hierarchy
requirements.description: When navigating intended capabilities, TTD SHOULD expose hierarchy, relationship meaning, mappings, exclusions and uncertainty with bounded focus queries.

validation.notes: Planned ONTOLOGY protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Recoverable accessible design experience
requirements.description: When users browse or review a design, TTD SHOULD support keyboard and textual graph access, compact layouts and loading, empty, partial, stale, validation, permission and recovery states.

validation.notes: Planned UX protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Evidence-aware contribution
requirements.description: When scenarios map to capabilities, TTD SHOULD distinguish proposed contribution, implemented contribution and verified fulfillment with source/evidence applicability.

validation.notes: Planned ONTOLOGY protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Reviewed bottom-up learning
requirements.description: When implementation evidence suggests ontology corrections, TTD SHOULD retain proposed changes as reviewable authored revisions rather than silently rewriting the intended model.

validation.notes: Planned ONTOLOGY protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Alternatives and retention
requirements.description: When proposals branch, change or are abandoned, TTD SHOULD preserve comparison, lineage, referenced reviewed content and explicit retention/deletion consequences.

validation.notes: Planned LIFECYCLE protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Qualified isolated experiments
requirements.description: Where draft execution is authorized, TTD SHOULD reuse qualified workspace and control-plane isolation and bind evidence to exact inputs, runtime identities, allowances and cleanup outcomes.

validation.notes: Planned EXPERIMENT protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Typed cross-surface parity
requirements.description: When a design operation is exposed, TTD SHOULD provide equivalent API, CLI and operator behavior for identity, findings, permissions and recovery without UI-only business rules.

validation.notes: Planned PARITY protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.
